rules.text: Purple mattresses can be returned within 100 calendar days of delivery.
rules.quote: Eligible Purple mattresses can be returned within **100 calendar days of delivery**.

rules.text: Purple pillows may be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery.
rules.quote: Eligible Purple pillows may be returned within **30 calendar days of delivery**.

rules.text: Purple seat cushions may be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery.
rules.quote: Eligible Purple Seat Cushions may be returned within **30 calendar days of delivery**.

rules.text: Purple bedding products may be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery.
rules.quote: Eligible bedding products may be returned within **30 calendar days of delivery**.

rules.text: Purple Squishy products, Freeform Extra Fill, Adjustable Bases, Smart Bases, Bed Frames, Platforms, Headboards, and Flat Foundations are not eligible for returns, refunds, or exchanges.
rules.quote:
The following products are not eligible for returns, refunds, or exchanges:

*   Purple Squishy™ products
*   Freeform™ Extra Fill
*   Adjustable Bases
*   Smart Bases
*   Bed Frames
*   Platforms
*   Headboards
*   Flat Foundations

rules.text: A 21-night adjustment period is required before returning a mattress.
Mattress must be clean and undamaged and law tag must remain attached to be eligible for return.
rules.quote:
Mattress must be clean and undamaged
*   Law tag must remain attached

rules.text: Pillow must be clean and undamaged to be eligible for return.
rules.quote: Pillow must be clean and undamaged

rules.text: Seat cushion must be clean and undamaged to be eligible for return.
rules.quote: Cushion must be clean and undamaged

rules.text: Bedding product must be clean and undamaged to be eligible for return.
rules.quote: Product must be clean and undamaged

rules.text: Customer is responsible for return shipping costs on bedding returns.
rules.quote: Customer is responsible for return shipping costs

rules.text: One mattress exchange is allowed during the 100-day trial period.
rules.quote: One mattress exchange is allowed during the trial period.

rules.text: Seat cushion exchanges are not available.
rules.quote: Seat cushion exchanges are not available.

rules.text: Refunds may take up to 14 business days to appear after processing.
rules.quote: After your return is processed and a refund is issued, it may take up to **14 business days** for the funds to appear in your account, depending on your financial institution.
